phrase.en: Two tickets, please. Is the museum open on Mondays?
phrase.ru: Два билета, пожалуйста. Музей открыт по понедельникам?
phrase.es: Dos entradas, por favor. ¿Está abierto el museo los lunes?

text.ru: Заказ — Two tickets, please. Время работы — Is it open? / What time does it open? Open здесь прилагательное: The museum is open.
text.en: Order with Two tickets, please. Ask about hours: Is it open? What time does it open? Open can be an adjective.
text.es: Two tickets, please. Is it open? What time does it open?

exercises.en: The museum is open until six.
